short_description: Provider enablement platform offering insurance credentialing, billing, and client matching for therapists and psychiatrists, with a focus on fast credentialing
long_description: Rula (formerly Path Mental Health) is a provider enablement platform designed to help therapists and psychiatrists build thriving insurance-based practices. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Los Angeles, California, Rula has raised over $100 million in funding to eliminate the barriers that prevent mental health providers from accepting insurance. The platform handles insurance credentialing, claims submission, payment processing, and actively matches providers with patients seeking care. Rula differentiates itself through faster-than-average credentialing times and competitive reimbursement rates, often claiming to offer higher rates than other platforms. The company is in-network with major insurance carriers including Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Anthem, and various Blue Cross Blue Shield plans. Providers maintain their independence as contractors while Rula handles the administrative complexity. Both therapists and psychiatric prescribers can join, with psychiatrists and PMHNPs benefiting from built-in e-prescribing capabilities. Rula takes a percentage of each session (approximately 10-15%) in exchange for credentialing, billing, and patient referrals. The platform's active matching system helps fill provider caseloads with patients covered by their accepted insurance plans.

faqs.q: How much do Rula therapists make per session?
faqs.a: Rula providers typically receive $90-160+ per session net after the platform fee, with psychiatrists generally earning more than therapists. Rula claims higher reimbursement rates than competitors. Actual rates depend on license type, location, and insurance payer. Payment is weekly via direct deposit.

faqs.q: How long does Rula credentialing take?
faqs.a: Rula credentialing typically takes 2-4 weeks, faster than the industry average of 4-8 weeks. Rula handles all paperwork and follow-up with insurance companies. You can start building your practice as soon as credentialing completes.

faqs.q: How does Rula compare to Headway and Grow Therapy?
faqs.a: Rula differentiates itself through faster credentialing times and claims of higher reimbursement rates. All three platforms offer similar services: credentialing, billing, and patient matching. Rula also supports psychiatrists with e-prescribing. Compare fees and rates for your specific situation.

Yes, Rula supports both therapists and psychiatric prescribers (psychiatrists and PMHNPs). The platform includes e-prescribing capabilities for controlled and non-controlled medications per state regulations. Psychiatrists typically earn higher per-session rates than therapists.
